name: Focused attention on breath

cues.text: Count each out-breath silently, from one to ten, then start again at one.
If you lose count, that is normal. Start again at one.
Keep your attention resting on the breath and the dot.
Let the counting go and rest for a moment.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel distressed or uneasy.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Rest your attention on the breath by counting it quietly.
copy.end: Let the counting go and notice how you feel now.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: No systematic review for breath counting was found. Research gives no pacing (silent counting of the natural breath); the default rate is an ambient, unguided visual dot only. Verify before release.
